events.title: Rulehouse Next Fest Broadcast
events.summary: This is a pre-recorded broadcast of our team playing Rulehouse's main story all the way through.

events.title: NEXT FEST & New Patch
events.summary: Hey everyone! A new day, a new event, and a new patch! Today marks the first day of Steam's NEXT FEST, it's a big deal in driving wishlists and potentially getting some funding for Rulehouse, so if you have the time, playing the new patch and dropping a Steam review today or tomorrow would help a lot! events.title: Rulehouse DEMO is LIVE!
events.summary: We just launched Rulehouse Demo on Steam! After winning Brackeys 26.1 Jam in mid-March and deciding to develop the game to a full release, it's been a little more than six months in development. We've fleshed out the story, polished the engine, redone all the art and are very proud of the game we've made. If you have the time please do check it out and we will be in Steam NEXT FEST in a couple weeks as well. Hope you guys play and like it and everyone on the team is excited to see your reviews o

events.title: Rulehouse in NEXT FEST!
events.summary: Rulehouse will be debuting in NEXT FEST on October 19th! We're putting the final touches on the demo as we speak and we're so excited to get Rulehouse in the hands of steam gamers and to hear what everyone thinks about it.
